purpose: Fresh second-eye questions selected from authored facts before running this question layer. Fixed for one bounded transfer check; not a sealed benchmark.

cases.question: My model has amount: 0, and the field has defaultValue: 10. Will building the field change it? If I call updateInitialValue() after an edit, what will a later resetModel() restore?
If I hide a field but need to keep its answer, does resetOnHide: false also keep its control registered?
Can I safely change an expression target from templateOptions.disabled to props.disabled when a parent field may be disabled?
I registered a plain core FieldType in a Material form. Does that supply the mat-form-field shell and Material control integration automatically?
Why can key: 'secret' and type: 'passwordBox' legitimately differ in one field config?
Which HTTP and RxJS pattern should I use to fetch an initial value after the fields have built, and exactly when should Formly write it?
